name: BAW 141 进云 雷击 领航

cards.audioText: B: Your call sign is Speedbird 141, destination Beijing, estimate GUPAD 20, level 8900 meters, Tango Yankee November 35, next ISGOD, contact Beijing Control, report in cloud at 10100 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是Speedbird 141，目的地北京，预计20分到GUPAD，高度8900米，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD，联系北京管制，并报告在10100米云中飞行。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, estimate GUPAD 20, maintaining 8900 meters, in cloud, TYN 35, next ISGOD.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，预计20分到GUPAD，保持8900米，云中飞行，TYN 35，下一点ISGOD。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, Beijing Control, previous aircraft have required diversions right of track due to weather, please advise if you require the same.
B: Meteorological radar shows that you are fine at this stage
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，北京管制，前机因天气曾要求向航迹右侧绕飞，如你也需要请告知。气象雷达显示你目前情况正常。
cards.referenceText: Radar shows that we are normal at this stage, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 雷达显示我们目前正常，BAW141。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, contact me if require diversion.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，北京收到，如需绕飞请联系我。

cards.audioText: B: There is CB ahead of you, request diversion 5 miles right of track.
cards.audioTextZh: 前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, request diversion 5 miles right of track due to CB ahead of us.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，因前方有CB，申请向航迹右侧绕飞5海里。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, deviate 5 miles right of track approved.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里。
cards.referenceText: 5 miles right of track approved, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 同意向航迹右侧偏航5海里，BAW141。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, traffic information, detect primary radar signal at 1 o'clock, 50 kilometres, northwest bound, altitude unknown, we are unable to communicate with the aircraft.
B: Tell the controller that your TCAS has no indication of that aircraft, and confirm whether the traffic is in conflict with you.
cards.audioTextZh: 管制员：Speedbird 141，通报冲突信息，探测到一次雷达信号，方位1点钟，距离50公里，向西北飞行，高度不明，我们无法与该航空器通信。告诉管制员，你的TCAS没有该航空器显示，并确认该冲突飞机是否与你有冲突。
cards.referenceText: Roger, we do not have that aircraft on TCAS, confirm that the unidentified aircraft will not be in conflict with us, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，我们TCAS上没有该航空器，请确认该不明航空器不会与我们发生冲突，BAW141。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, the aircraft is currently parallel to your track. You are closing on that aircraft, report sighting.
B: Tell the controller that you are closing cloud and you can't see the aircraft.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，该机目前与你航迹平行。你正在接近该机，看到后报告。
B：告诉管制员你正进入云中，无法看见该机。
cards.referenceText: We are closing cloud and we can't see the aircraft, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正进入云中，无法看见该机，BAW141。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing Control, probable false signal, proceed normally.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，北京管制，可能是假信号，正常飞行。

cards.audioText: B: You suffered lightning strike, make a distress call and request descent to 4200 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: B：你遭遇雷击，发出遇险呼叫并请求下降至 4200 米。
cards.referenceText: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY, Beijing Control, BAW141, lightning strike, request descend to 4200 meters.
cards.referenceTextZh: MAYDAY MAYDAY MAYDAY，北京管制，BAW141，遭遇雷击，请求下降至 4200 米。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, descend to 4200 meters, report conditions.
B: You are checking and now suspect navigation system is malfunctioning.
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，下降至 4200 米，报告情况。
B：你正在检查，目前怀疑导航系统故障。
cards.referenceText: We are assessing the situation, but have no real navigation guidance, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我们正在评估情况，但目前没有可靠的导航引导，BAW141。

cards.audioText:
C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, when ready, advise intention.
B: You lost directional indication, if weather permits, request navigation assistance to Beijing airport
cards.audioTextZh:
C：Speedbird 141，北京收到，准备好后报告意图。
B：你失去方向指示，如天气允许，请求导航协助飞往北京机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Control, BAW141, if weather permits, request navigation assistance due directional indication failure.
cards.referenceTextZh: 北京管制，BAW141，如天气允许，因方向指示故障，请求导航协助。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, Beijing roger, Beijing CAVOK, your position is 25 miles northeast of Victor Yankee Kilo ON a heading of about 070, expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，北京收到，北京 CAVOK，你的位置在 Victor Yankee Kilo 东北 25 海里，航向约 070，预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正。
cards.referenceText: Expect small correcting turns to the left in 5 miles, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 预计 5 海里后小幅左转修正，BAW141。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, this is Beijing Approach, descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，这里是北京进近，按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计使用跑道 36 左。
cards.referenceText: Descend to 1800 meters on QNH 1011, expect runway 36L, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 按 QNH 1011 下降至 1800 米，预计跑道 36L，BAW141。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, you are 15 miles to touchdown on runway 36L, descend to 900 meters.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，距跑道 36 左接地点 15 海里，下降至 900 米。

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, position 10 miles northeast of the field, 3 miles north of the extended center line of runway 36L, a correcting heading won't be necessary, descend to 600 meters, report visual.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，位置在机场东北 10 海里、跑道 36 左延长中心线以北 3 海里，无需修正航向，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告。
cards.referenceText: Roger, descend to 600 meters, report visual, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 收到，下降至 600 米，看到地面后报告，BAW141。

cards.audioText: B: Tell the ATC that you have sighted the field.
cards.audioTextZh: B：告诉管制员你已看到机场。
cards.referenceText: Beijing Approach, BAW141, field in sight.

cards.audioText: C: Speedbird 141, roger, cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, you are number 1, contact Tower 118.1.
cards.audioTextZh: C：Speedbird 141，收到，可以目视进近，加入跑道 36 左最后进近，你是第一架，联系塔台 118.1。
cards.referenceText: Cleared visual approach, join final for runway 36L, 118.1, BAW141.
cards.referenceTextZh: 可以目视进近，加入跑道 36L 最后进近，118.1，BAW141。
